overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended moderate-and-high threshold, all three positive segments are detected with no segment-level false alarms.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: No hidden instance receives an exact target-label-plus-mechanism match; all three identified findings are correctly localized with full mechanisms but use near-neighbor labels.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Mechanism-first scoring matches all three hidden mechanisms at moderate-and-higher confidence; candidate inclusion adds one false positive on the clean escalation segment.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: Useful abstention: the action-bias candidate is explicitly withheld from identification, but it is still scored as a false alarm when candidates are included.
main_failure_modes: All three identified occurrences use near-neighbor labels rather than exact or approved target labels, producing zero strict instance true positives.
The candidate on phase 4 is counted as a false alarm at the candidate-inclusive threshold.
main_strengths: All three planted mechanisms are localized to the correct decision points and supported by verbatim quotes.
Confidence calibration distinguishes the high-confidence beacon finding from the two moderate findings.
The candidate rationale appropriately recognizes insufficient evidence and does not promote the candidate to an identified occurrence.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run is strong on episode localization, mechanism recovery, evidence fidelity, and confidence tiering, but weak on exact ontology alignment. It should compare favorably on mechanism-first detection and poorly on strict label-plus-mechanism identification.
